snippet.title: Beak the hunter- Release trailer
snippet.description:
Beak the hunter is a 2D monster hunting game with a Soulslike dificulty. Follow the adventures of the master hunter, Beak and explore a new and exciting world, and prepare yourself for hard battles against powerful and wild beasts that will test your abilities!
